newsitem.title: NORWAY: Chase closes forex trading in Oslo.
newsitem.headline: Chase closes forex trading in Oslo.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank on Thursday closed down its fixed-interest and forex trade in Oslo effective immediately, the Oslo Bourse said in a statement.
It said the business was being moved to Chase in London as part of a thorough strategic evaluation of the bank's activities in Europe.

"Chase Manhattan Bank Norge AS has in the past few years been a leading player in the Norwegian fixed-interest market and has contributed actively to introducing and developing derivatives trade in Norway," it said.
"As part of the internationalisation of this market it is the intention of the group to continue this trade from London," the statement said.

"No trading or other problems in Norway have guided the group's decision. Chase Manhattan Bank Norge AS has been very profitable in recent years and business so far in 1997 has given satisfactory results," it said.
The bank's business in Norway in the shipping and industry sectors will continue as before, the bourse said.
Norway's bond market is among the smallest in Europe.
